definitions.gloss: one's favorite person (especially idol or character)
definitions.explanation: A person, character, or thing that one strongly supports or is a fan of. From the verb {推|お}す (to recommend/support).

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{推|お}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アイドル→アイドル：05111_aidoru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{推|お}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グッズ→グッズ：10800_guzzu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めています→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: I collect merchandise of my favorite.

examples.japanese: {推|お}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}いしました→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。

notes:
{推|お}し is modern slang referring to one's favorite person, typically an idol, celebrity, or fictional character one strongly supports.

ETYMOLOGY:
From the verb ⟦{推|お}す→推す：12798_osu⟧ (to recommend/push). Originally idol fandom term, now mainstream.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {推|お}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to have a favorite
- {推|お}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to support one's favorite
- {推|お}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グッズ→グッズ：10800_guzzu⟧: merch of one's favorite

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{推|お}し{活|かつ}→推し活：06580_oshikatsu⟧: fan activities
- {推|お}し⟦メン→メン：noentry⟧: favorite member (of a group)
- {推|お}し⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧: changing one's favorite
- {推|お}し⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: color representing one's favorite
- ⟦{箱推|はこお}し→箱推し：15696_hakooshi⟧: supporting the whole group

CULTURAL NOTE:
{推|お}し culture is huge in Japan, covering idols, anime characters, VTubers, and more. "{推|お}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{推|お}せる→推す：12798_osu⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{推|お}せ→推す：12798_osu⟧" (Support your favorite while you can) is a common saying.
